text: Launch beat: call to action for Tidepool, a note-taking app that links related ideas automatically. 16:9, about 6 s, silent. Palette: deep navy #0B1F3A background, white #FFFFFF type, coral #FF6B35 accent. Camera: static. Scenes: 0-2 s hook - the headline "Notes that think" rises into the centre in white, word by word. 2-4.5 s feature - on the left, "Auto-link every idea" slides in; on the right, three coral note cards connect with lines. 4.5-6 s call to action - a coral button reading "Try Tidepool free" pops in at the centre and holds still to the end. Motion: snappy ease-out, nothing loops. Preserve generous text boxes so no copy clips or overlaps, and show only wording explicitly requested by this brief.
